sources.title: Immigration and General Services
sources.publisher: Ministry of Revenue and Customs, Government of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: Revenue's official Government immigration-services URL is the operational source for a named arrival-visitor cohort and an all-other-countries statement. At cross-review its server presented an incomplete TLS issuer chain, so normal secure retrieval failed; it is not used as independently verifiable current residual-schedule evidence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of all other countries need visas to enter Tonga prior to arrival.

sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga in the People’s Republic of China
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy of Tonga in China page gives a competing named list and says unlisted travellers obtain a letter of authority before applying on arrival. Its page footer says Copyright 2018 and it does not state a later update, so it cannot control a current exhaustive nationality complement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: requires a letter of authority allowing him/her to travel to Tonga and apply on arrival

sources.title: Immigration Act, Chapter 10.01 (revised legislation)
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: Tonga's Attorney General publishes the revised Immigration Act and its 2025 amendment. The Act grants visitor-permit and visa powers but does not publish the current nationality categories needed to resolve the two operational sources.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visitor permit may be issued at the discretion of an immigration officer.

sources.title: Immigration Regulations, Chapter 10.01.01
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General's Office publishes the revised regulations, including visitor-permit forms and fees, but no exhaustive ordinary-passport nationality schedule or publication-date reconciliation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitor’s Permit for non-citizens who require permits for entry.

sources.title: Gazettes by Year: 2026
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General's Office current 2026 Gazette index does not publish an immigration nationality-schedule reconciliation for the differing Revenue and Embassy visitor lists.
